source: She looked at the message that was blinking in the browser window and took another glance at the name of the sender.
target: Illud nuntium, quod in fenestra interretiali micabat, aspexit et nomen mittentis iterum contemplata est.

source: She knew who they were.
target: Sciebat qui essent.

source: Everyone who worked in the same circles as she did knew who they were.
target: Omnes qui in eandis circulis, sicut ipsa, laborabant, sciebant qui essent.

source: LazyPhoenix rose to infamy just like their namesake.
target: LazyPhoenix, sicut nomen ipsius indicat, ad infamiam ascendit.

source: They knew things nobody should know and had access to things nobody should have.
target: Sciebant res, quas nemo scire debuit, et accessum habebant ad ea, quae nemo habere debuit.

source: The speculations on the forums (and in private) ran rampant, with everybody trying to figure out where they came from, and who pissed them off that they were so generous with what was, more than likely, insider information.
target: Speculationes in forum (et in privato) pervagabantur, dum omnes conabantur perscrutari unde originem haberent, et quis eos iraserit quod tam largiter communicabant, quae probabiliter erant notitiae intimae.

source: Personally, before today, she didn’t care much.
target: Personaliter, ante hunc diem, parum curabat.

source: People like LazyPhoenix popped up now and then, and then crashed and burned when their fame got into their head, and did or said something inadvisable.
target: Homines similes LazyPhoenix aliquando apparuērunt, deinde ruērunt et combusti sunt, cum fama in mentem eorum intrasset, et aliquid inprudenter fecerunt aut dixerunt.

source: But LazyPhoenix didn’t talk to people.
target: Sed LazyPhoenix cum hominibus non loquebatur.

source: They didn’t brag about their knowledge or fame on any social media.
target: Non gloriabatur de sua scientia aut fama in ulla retia sociali.

source: They were only active on one site, and even there, their interaction with people was businesslike.
target: Solum in uno situ erant activi, et etiam ibi eorum commercium cum hominibus negotiale erat.

source: They sold information and nothing more.
target: Notitias vendebant et nihil ultra.

source: And now she was here, staring at a message from the aforementioned person, offering her information.
target: Et nunc illa aderat, intuens nuntium a praedicta persona, ei informationem offerentem.

source: Three favors.
target: Tres beneficia.

source: From her.
target: Ab ea.

source: A person who was at best a small-time streamer.
target: Persona, quae ad minimum, parvus emissarius ludorum esset.

source: For a moment, she even thought it was some kind of scam.
target: Per momentum, etiam putavit id esse aliquam fraudem.

source: But she couldn’t exactly point out what kind of scam it could be.
target: Sed non potuit exacte indicare quidnam fraudis genus esset.

source: In the end, she couldn’t help it; her curiosity overwhelmed her and she accepted the offer.
target: Demum, non potuit se repugnare; eius curiositas eam opprimebat, atque oblationem accepit.

source: She expected a well-formatted document with a list of tasks or something along those lines, but apparently, the game was new enough that even LazyPhoenix couldn’t showcase their usual meticulousness.
target: Exspectabat documentum bene ordinatum cum indice munerum aut similibus, sed apparuit ludus satis novus esse ut etiam LazyPhoenix consuetam accuratam diligentiam suam ostendere non posset.

source: Instead, she was practically treated to a few videos, with parts highlighted, links to stories from people, and even some clips from her own stream.
target: Proinde, paucis video ei praebita erant, cum partibus illustratis, nexus ad fabulas hominum, atque etiam aliqua fragmenta ex sua ipsius emissione.

source: It was definitely weird, but LazyPhoenix was the guy who knew.
target: Certe mirum erat, sed LazyPhoenix vir erat qui sciebat.

source: So, she just shrugged and wrote down the instructions.
target: Itaque illa humeros sublevavit et praecepta scripsit.

source: It was worth the try…
target: Conatus certe valuit…

source: Sometime later, she stared down at the stone tablet in the middle of the cavern, decorated with crystals jutting out of the ground and the ceiling, all pulsing with mystical light.
target: Aliquando postea, illa intuebatur lapidem tabulam in medio speluncae, ornatam crystallis eminenti ex terra et laqueario, omnibus luce mystica pulsante.

source: The cavern itself was humongous, as she couldn’t actually see its end, only the twinkling of the crystals in the distance like stars on a clear night.
target: Ipsa spelunca ingens erat, nam finem eius videre non potuit, sed solum micantia crystallorum in longinquo, quasi stellae in serena nocte.

source: The journey to reach the place wasn’t arduous, but without the hints she was given, she would have never found it.
target: Iter ad locum attingendum non erat arduum, sed sine indicibus datis, numquam illum inveniret.

source: And as she saw several people near the locations while she was doing the requisite quests, she knew she only had a small window to acquire it.
target: Et cum plures homines prope locos observasset, dum quaestiones necessarias perficiendis versabatur, scivit se occasionem parvam habere ad id adipiscendum.

source: So, with a small trepidation, she reached out for the tablet and prayed that the quest was true, and it would really give her the thing she was promised.
target: Itaque, parvo cum tremore, ad tabulam manum extendit et oravit ut quaestus verus esset, et vere ei id daret quod promissum fuerat.

source: As her hand got closer, she could hear an audible hum coming from the crystals, and the pulsing sped up.
target: Dum manus eius appropinquabat, sonum humile ex crystallis audire potuit, et pulsus celerius fieri coepit.

source: Then her fingers touched the stone tablet, and a deluge of notifications appeared in front of her.
target: Tum digiti eius lapidem tabulam tetigerunt, et inundatio notificationum coram ea apparuit.

source: [Congratulations! You found one of the Tablets of Creation!]
target: [Gratulatio! Unam ex Tabulis Creationis invenisti!]

source: [Thanks to your luck and attention to detail you gain +1 LUK, +3 PER, and +1 WIS!]
target: [Propter fortunam tuam ac diligentiam, consequeris +1 LUK, +3 PER, et +1 WIS!]

source: [The Tablet of Creation reaches out to you…]
target: [Tabula Creationis ad te tendit…]

source: [The Tablet of Creation finds you worthy!]
target: [Tabula Creationis te dignum invenit!]

source: [The Tablet of Creation grants you the Knowledge of Crystal Geomancy!]
target: [Tabula Creationis tibi dat scientiam Geomantiae crystallinae!]

source: [Crystal Geomancy: Level MAX (Passive) You are able to summon an ethereal book that contains the knowledge of how to build artifacts, items, and most importantly, golems out of crystals.]
target: [Geomantia Crystallina: Gradus MAX (Passivus) Possides facultatem evocandi librum aetherium, qui continet scientiam quomodo artificia, instrumenta, et maxime golemos ex crystallis construi possint.]

source: She stared for a moment, and while she was reading the screens that appeared, the stone tablet, which so far looked like an ordinary stone tablet, began to shine with the same light as the surrounding crystals.
target: Per momentum intuebatur, et dum ea quae apparuerant legebat, lapis tabula, quae usque nunc ut simplex tabula lapidea visa erat, incipiebat eadem luce, ac crystalla circumjacentia splendescere.

source: Then it began to pulse, and before she could react, it flashed brightly enough that she went blind for a second, and when she managed to blink the flashes out of her eyes, the tablet was gone, and crystals were losing their own shine.
target: Tum incipiebat pulsare, et antequam reagere posset, tam fulgide micuit ut per momentum caeca esset; et cum conata esset fulgura ex oculis extinguere, tabula evanuit, et crystalla suum splendorem amittere coeperunt.

source: Instead, she was greeted with another notification.
target: Proinde, alia notificatio eam salutavit.

source: [The Tablet of Creation found your lonely journey worth a reward!]
target: [Tabula Creationis iter solitarium tuum praemio dignum invenit!]

source: [The Tablet of Creation granted you the Crystal Heart skill!]
target: [Tabula Creationis tibi concedit artem Cordis Crystallini!]

source: [Crystal Heart: Level MAX (Passive) Your heart turned to mana crystal, and while it will operate the same way your old heart did, it will also confer you several blessings. Your base mana gain from Magic will be doubled. Your base Mana Regeneration is doubled. The base number of crystal creations you can control is doubled. Grants you the Crystal Affinity skill.]
target: [Cor Crystallinum: Gradus MAX (Passivum) Cor tuum in crystallum manae conversum est, et dum eodem modo operabitur, quem modo cor vetus tuum fungebatur, nonnullas benedictiones tibi conferet. Fundamentalis acquisitio manae ex Magia duplicabitur. Regeneratio manae fundamentalis duplicata erit. Numerus fundamentalium creationum crystallorum, quos regere potes, duplicatus est. Tribuit tibi artem Affinitatis Crystallinae.]

source: She stared for a long moment, and the next moment the rapidly darkening cavern was echoing with curses that would make a ship’s worth of sailors blush.
target: Illa diu intuebatur, et mox spelunca, rapidissime obscurata, resonabat maledictis quae tot nautae in classe navali rubescere facerent.

source: “Now I can’t even show it off on the stream! Fuck!”
target: “Nunc illud in emissione quidem ostendere nequeo! Merda!”

source: Dave liked money.
target: Dave pecuniam amabat.

source: However, he didn’t like to work.
target: Attamen laborare non placebat.

source: That is why he found the perfect compromise.
target: Hinc optimum medium invenit.

source: Crime.
target: Crimen.

source: But Dave also liked games, and that was how he found out about gold farming groups and their associated activities.
target: Sed Dave etiam ludos amabat, et ita didicit de coetibus ad aurum colligendum et operibus eorum associatis.

source: It didn’t take long for him to shift his own group into a “professional” gaming group, while those who were a little behind on their rent were asked to play a game for a while.
target: Non multum temporis fuit ut suum coetum in gregem ludorum professionalium convertirentur, dum illi, qui paulum in merceda sero erant, ad ludendum aliquod tempus invitabantur.

source: It was a win-win for everyone.
target: Id omnibus utiliter profuit.

source: He made money, didn’t have to work, and got to play video games.
target: Pecuniam faciebat, laborare non oportebat, atque video ludos ludere poterat.

source: And then Magic Unbound came out.
target: Et deinde Magic Unbound edita est.

source: It was the latest in the lines of the revolutionary VR games, and while everyone waited to see if it was actually worth the hype, Dave spotted an opportunity.
target: Novissimum erat in serie ludorum VR revolutionariorum, et dum omnes exspectabant videre utrum vere praestaret, Dave opportunitatem deprehendit.

source: Roleplaying games always needed thugs and bandits, and he had a decent collection of them.
target: Ludi partes agendi semper scelestos et latrones requirebant, et habebat satis bonam collectionem eorum.

source: And while they were away doing what they did best (or at least trying not to mess up) he could take his main group and create a proper guild that would be the face of his business.
target: Et dum illi optimam operam dabat in officiis suis (aut saltem conabantur ne male agerent), poterat coetum suum principale sumere et creare societatem idoneam, quae faciem negotii eius praebebit.

source: And look, he was right!
target: Et ecce, recte erat!

source: The game was amazing, didn’t need people to race for the highest level, and there were secrets everywhere. Which meant there was money to be made everywhere.
target: Ludus mirabilis erat, neque requirebat ut homines certarent in altissimo gradu, et ubique arcana erant. Quod significabat ubique pecuniam faciendam esse.

source: Then, one day, he received a message.
target: Tum, uno die, nuntium accepit.

source: Some of his boys were killed.
target: Quidam ex pueris eius interfecti sunt.

source: Dave didn’t really care, as this was a game.
target: Dave re vera non curabat, nam hoc erat ludus.

source: He cared more about how they were defeated.
target: Ei magis curabat quomodo superati essent.

source: A player with amazing skills and spells that they haven’t seen yet?
target: Ludens cum praeclaris artibus et incantamentis, quae nondum viderant?

source: Now that was more interesting.
target: Iam id magis interest.

source: He looked up from his tablet at his assistant.
target: Ex tabula sua aspexit adiutorem suum.

source: “Get the info from the guys, and tell our people to keep an eye for the guy. I want to know where he got the skills.”
target: “Accipe informationes ab illis, et dic nostris ut vigiles sint de eo; scire volo unde artes acceperit.”

source: The man standing in front of him nodded, then made some notes on his own tablet.
target: Vir, qui ante eum stabat, annuit, deinde in tabula sua nonnulla notavit.

source: “Should they… ask, or…” he replied leadingly.
target: “Num... quaerere debeant, an…” inquit prae se ferens.

source: Dave thought about it a little before answering.
target: Dave paulum de hoc cogitavit, antequam respondeat.

source: “Nah, we are at the beginning of the game. Just follow him and see if we can steal his quests.”
target: “Non, ludus solum in initio est. Sequimini eum et videatis an possimus eius quaestiones subrumpere.”

source: “Yes, sir. Do you want us to offer him money for it?”
target: “Ita, domine. Visne ut illi pecuniam pro ea offeramus?”

source: Dave just simply waved the man away, annoyed.
target: Dave virum manu repulit, irritatus.

source: “What for? It’s not like he expects us. And our boys are good.”
target: “Quidnam? Non enim nos exspectat. Et pueri nostri boni sunt.”

source: He thought for a second, then nodded a little. “If all else fails, we can just kill him until he gives up his secrets.”
target: Paulo cogitavit, deinde leviter annuit. “Si omnia aliter deficiant, eum interficere possumus, donec secreta sua tradat.”

source: The other man nodded.
target: Alter vir annuit.

source: “Understood, sir. I’ll make the arrangements.”
target: “Intelligo, domine. Dispositiones faciam.”

source: Stephen, at first, was annoyed with the guy that had that adorable wolf with his short, and basically useless description of the process of acquiring a pet, but in the end, he just shrugged and put it behind him.
target: Stephen, initio, de viro, qui illum amabilem lupum cum brevi et fere inutili descriptione de pet accipiendi processu haberet, irritatus erat; sed demum humeros sublevavit et illud abiecit.

source: True, he was out of a few silvers, but now he knew where to go.
target: Vere, paucis argentis caret, sed nunc scivit quo ire.

source: In his previous quest, he talked to one of the rangers, so he naturally knew where to find the woman.
target: In quaestione praeterita, cum unum ex rangeris locutus esset, naturaliter scivit ubi eam invenire posset.

source: Though it was a little annoying that if he hadn’t asked that guy for it, he wouldn’t have known to talk to the ranger to get a pet.
target: Quamquam paulum molestum erat, quod nisi illum virum rogavisset, nesciret se ad ranger loquendum esse ut pet adipisceretur.

source: As he walked toward his destination, he couldn’t help but talk out loud.
target: Dum ad destinationem iter faciebat, non potuit non voce alta loqui.

source: “Man, this game is hardcore, but such fun!”
target: “Heus, hic ludus est durissimus, sed tam iucundum!”

source: A random guy next to him also exclaimed.
target: Aliquis ignotus iuxta eum quoque exclamavit.

source: “Right?!”
target: “Recte?!”

source: They exchanged a high-five and Stephen continued on his travel, while the guy began to extoll the game’s good points to an unfortunate bystander.
target: Manum altam inter se commutaverunt, et Stephen iter suum continuavit, dum ille vir bonus ludi rationes in infortunatum transeuntem clare enarrantem incipiebat.

source: Stephen approached the small building on the outskirts of the town, opened the small gate, and stepped into the courtyard of the house, surrounded by a low stone wall.
target: Stephen appropinquavit parvo aedificio in proximo extraneo oppidi, parvum portam aperuit et in atrium domus ingressus est, parvo muro lapideo circadatum.

source: Inside the courtyard were several people preparing to head out, maintaining their gear, or talking to each other.
target: In atrio complures erant, qui se praeparabant ad exitionem, apparatum suum conservabant, aut inter se colloquebantur.

source: Stephen ignored the collection of rangers and headed directly for the severe woman standing in the corner of the courtyard, observing the activities.
target: Stephen coetum rangerorum neglexit et directe accessit ad severam mulierem in angulo atrii stantem, quae actiones observabat.

source: He made eye contact with the woman, and when he received a small nod, he approached her.
target: Oculos cum muliere contulit, et cum parvus annuit, ad eam accessit.

source: “Hail, Ranger Rose!” he called out, offering a deep bow.
target: “Ave, Ranger Rose!” exclamavit, profundum inclinavit.

source: “Young Stephen, well met,” came the deep and husky voice of the ranger in front of him.
target: “Iuvenis Stephen, bene convenisti,” exclamavit vox profunda et rauca ranger, qui ante eum stabat.

source: “How can I help you today?” she asked, then smirked a little.
target: “Quomodo te hodie adiuvare possum?” inquit, deinde leviter subsurridens.

source: “You need more help with differentiating weed from herbs?”
target: “Plusne tibi opus est auxilio in distinguendo inter herbas spurcas et herbas útiles?”

source: “Not today, Ranger Rose,” he answered, his cheeks pinking a little in embarrassment.
target: “Non hodie, Ranger Rose,” respondit, cum genae eius paulum roseae fierent.

source: “Then what brought you to my yard, young man?” she asked with a raised eyebrow.
target: “Quid ergo te ad domum meam attulit, iuvenis?” inquit, supercilio elevato.

source: Stephen almost answered with ‘milk’ but in the end, he managed to control himself.
target: Stephen paene respondit ‘lac’, sed denique se continere potuit.

source: ‘Curse those memes…’
target: ‘Maledictis memis…’

source: He cleared his throat and began talking.
target: Guttur suum purgavit et coepit loqui.

source: “I was wondering if you could help me acquire a pet…”
target: “Mirabar utrum poteris me adiuvare ad pet adipiscendum…”

source: There was a moment as the ranger stared at him, then she snorted.
target: Aliquid momentum fuit, dum ranger in eum intuebatur, deinde sufflavit.

source: “That’s it?”
target: “Idne est?”

source: “Well… yeah.”
target: “Ita… ita.”

source: “Alright! We are preparing to head out, come with us, and I’ll show you the ropes.”
target: “Bene! Nos praeparamus ad exitionem, veni nobiscum, et tibi ostendam viam.”

source: “For the traps?”
target: “Ad laqueos?”

source: “For the traps.”
target: “Ad laqueos.”

source: Stephen stared at the beast in front of him. Taking it in as its eyes glinted intelligently back at him.
target: Stephen bestiam, quae ante eum stabat, intueri coepit, dum oculi eius callide ad eum micabant.

source: He observed as its fur rose and fell as the creature breathed.
target: Animadvertit quomodo pellis eius surgere et cadere videbatur, dum creatura respirabat.

source: He slowly reached out with a hand, and began to stroke the creature’s very soft and delicate fur, wondering at its dark gray color.
target: Lente manum extendit et coepit mollissimam atque teneram creaturae pellem palpare, mirans de colore eius obscuro cinereo.

source: As he continued to caress the beast, he took in the horn, as the tip of it looked sharp enough to get through his armor.
target: Dum bestiam palpabat, cornu eius attendit, cuius apicem acutum esse videbatur, satis ut armaturam suam perforet.

source: Fortunately, or unfortunately, depending on who you asked, the beast had no claws.
target: Fortunate, vel infortunatim, secundum interrogationem, bestia ungues non habebat.

source: Just as Stephen was about to talk to the creature when he heard a twig break behind.
target: Ita ut Stephen ad loquendum cum creatura se coniungeret, frutex post eum rumpi audivit.

source: Knowing who he was with, he was pretty sure that the noise was deliberate.
target: Quod scivit cum quo esset, satis certus erat sonum esse deliberatum.

source: The creature in front of him froze at the sight, and he simply turned around, his hand continuing to caress the soft fur.
target: Creatura, quae ante eum stabat, aspectu immobilis facta est, et ille simpliciter vertit, dum manus eius mollissimam pellem palpare pergebat.

source: “Yes, Ranger Rose?”
target: “Ita, Ranger Rose?”

source: The woman gave him and the creature behind him a long look, then looked back at him.
target: Mulier ei ac creaturae, quae post eum stabat, longum conspectum dedit, deinde ad eum respexit.

source: “Is this your final choice, Stephen?”
target: “Estne haec electio ultima tua, Stephen?”

source: “Yes,” he answered without thinking. The moment he spotted the beast, he knew it was meant to be.
target: “Ita,” respondit sine cogitatione. Statim bestiam conspexit, intellexit id fatum esse.

source: “All right, in the end, it is your decision. But I must warn you, your path will not be an easy one.”
target: “Bene, demum, electio tua est. Sed te monere debeo: via tua non facile erit.”

source: Stephen just nodded.
target: Stephen iterum annuit.

source: “I’ll make do.”
target: “Me accommodabo.”

source: The ranger gave him another long, measuring look, then nodded.
target: Ranger illi alium longum aspectum examinans dedit, deinde annuit.

source: “Very well. Then this is what you need to do…”
target: “Optime. Ergo hoc est quod tibi faciendum est…”

source: Stephen walked back into the town of Greenwood with a pep in his steps, pride in his heart. And the most adorable and fluffy bunny in his arms.
target: Stephen in oppidum Greenwood rediit, cum vigore in passibus suis et superbia in corde; ac cuniculus amabilissimus et lanuginosus in bracchiis suis.

source: Slathor the Younger, Destroyer of Worlds, Ending of Universes, or for short, Slathy was a big, fluffy horned rabbit, common around Greenwood.
target: Slathor Iunior, Mundi Exterminator, Universorum Finitor, sive breviter Slathy, erat magnus, lanuginosus, corniger cuniculus, qui communis erat circa Greenwood.

source: And the reason Stephen chose him, and not a wolf as he originally planned, was because the little bunny was able to evade all of his traps when he went out to gather food for dinner, under the orders of the head ranger.
target: Causa cur Stephen eum elegit, et non lupum, ut initio destinaverat, erat quod parvus cuniculus omnes laqueos eius evadere poterat, cum pro cena cibum colligere iret sub praeceptis capitis rangeris.

source: The bunny was too intelligent for wildlife.
target: Cuniculus nimis callidus erat ad animalia silvestria.

source: And as he approached his friends, who upon seeing Slathy, immediately gathered around him (including several girls, which included his crush) and began to pet and coo at the bunny, as he sat in his arms imperiously looking at the surrounding people, just as an emperor would look at their subjects.
target: Et cum ad amicos suos accessit, qui Slathy viso statim circa eum congregati sunt (inter quos varias puellas, inter quas etiam eius cupiditas), et coepere cuniculum amplecti atque suave affari incipiebant, dum ille in brachiis suis imperiose sedebat et circumstantibus spectabat quasi imperator subditos suos.

source: ‘I really need to thank that guy…’ Stephen thought, then with a smile turned to Julia and began to tell the slightly embellished tale about how he acquired his adorable rabbit.
target: “Vere illi viro gratias agere mihi oportet…” cogitavit Stephen, deinde cum risu ad Juliam se convertit et parvam fabulam paulo ampliatam narrandi initiavit de eo, quomodo cuniculum amabilem adipiscitus esset.
